units.source_text: 大家都以为：源氏公子对世间寻常女子，即使一时逢场作戏，亦不屑一顾，不肯一问；

en.t: Everyone had thought that Prince Genji would not spare even a glance or a question for ordinary women of the world, even if he happened to amuse himself with them for a moment;

units.source_text: 必须是在世间略有好评而确有惹人心目之处的人，他才肯追求。

en.t: only someone with some reputation in society and a genuine power to attract people's eyes and hearts would be worth his pursuit.

units.source_text: 但如今恰恰相反，把一个毫不足取的末摘花看作了不起的人物，究竟出于何心？

en.t: But now the very opposite was happening: what could he possibly have in mind, treating the utterly unremarkable Suetsumuhana as someone extraordinary?
It must have been a bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 常陆宫邸内上下诸人中，以前有不少人以为小姐永无翻身之日，因此看她不起，各自纷纷散去。

en.t: Among the people high and low in the Hitachi Prince's household, many had once thought the lady would never have a chance to recover her position, so they looked down on her and drifted away one after another.

units.source_text: 现在又争先恐后地回来了。

en.t: Now they were hurrying back, each eager to be first.

units.source_text: 这位小姐谦虚恭谨，是个好主人，替她当侍女真好安乐。

en.t: This lady was modest and courteous, a good mistress, and serving as her attendant was truly peaceful and easy.

units.source_text: 后来她们转到庸庸碌碌的暴发的地方官家里当侍女，

en.t: Later, when they had gone to serve in the households of dull, newly risen provincial officials,

units.source_text: 便觉处处都看不惯，事事都不称心，

en.t: they found everything unfamiliar and unpleasant, and nothing suited them,

units.source_text: 虽然显得有些趋炎附势，也都回来了。

en.t: so even though it made them seem somewhat opportunistic, they all came back.

units.source_text: 源氏公子的权势比从前更加隆盛，待人接物也比从前更加亲切了。

en.t: Prince Genji's power was even greater than before, and he treated people with more kindness than he had in the past.

units.source_text: 末摘花家，万事都由公子亲自仔细调度，

en.t: In Suetsumuhana's household, the prince personally and carefully arranged every matter,

units.source_text: 那宫邸就骤见光彩，邸内人手也渐渐众多了。

en.t: and the mansion suddenly took on a new brightness, while the number of servants within it gradually increased.

units.source_text: 庭院中本来树木芜杂，蔓草丛生，荒凉满目，阴森可怕；

en.t: The garden had originally been full of tangled trees and rampant vines, desolate as far as the eye could see, gloomy and frightening;

units.source_text: 现在池塘都打捞清楚，树木都修剪齐整，气象焕然一新。

en.t: now the ponds had all been cleared, the trees neatly pruned, and the whole place looked completely renewed.

units.source_text: 那些不得源氏公子重用的下仆，都希图露露脸。

en.t: Those lower servants who had not won Prince Genji's favor all hoped for a chance to make themselves noticed.

units.source_text: 他们看见主人如此宠爱末摘花，都来讨好她，伺候她。

en.t: Seeing their master show such affection for Suetsumuhana, they all came to flatter her and attend on her.
